description: Multichain RPC read: One read-only JSON-RPC call on base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, base-sepolia (eth_call, eth_getBalance, eth_getLogs up to 1,000 blocks, eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_feeHistory and the rest of the read allow-list). Pass method and a JSON params array. Source: publicnode JSON-RPC. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: network, chain_id, method, params, result (the node's answer), ms.
